result.process_description:
If goods shall be shipped, the secretary clarifies who will do the shipping. 
If you have large amounts, special shipping will be necessary. 
In these cases the secretary invites three logistic companies to make offers and she selects one of them. 
In case of small amounts, normal post shipment is used. 
Therefore a package label is written by the secretary and a parcel insurance taken by the logistics department head if necessary. 
In the meantime the goods can be already packaged by the warehousemen. 
If everything is ready, the packaged goods are prepared for being picked up by the logistic company.

result.rule: When the description says the team may optionally carry out one of two or more separately named activities joined by 'or', and the rest of the process continues whether or not that optional work is done: Model each named alternative as its own task. Place an exclusive decision gateway before them, with one outgoing flow to each task and one bypass flow that skips the optional work. Merge all of these paths at one exclusive merge gateway before the next step. Do not collapse the alternatives into a single task, and do not connect the bypass or the task outputs directly to the next step without that merge.

When the description states one sentence in which a performer or performer group carries out two distinct activities joined by 'and', where the second activity responds to or resolves issues raised by the first: Model each of the two activities as its own task, in the order stated in the sentence, connected by a sequence flow. Do not merge them into one task whose label combines both actions, and do not drop either activity from the model.

When the description states that two or more separately named activities are each performed only if necessary, so that any combination of them, including only one or none, may occur before the flow continues: Model an inclusive split gateway before the conditional activities, with one outgoing flow to each activity, and an inclusive join gateway after them, before the next step, so the join waits only for the branches that were activated. Do not use an exclusive gateway, which would allow only one activity, and do not use a parallel gateway, which would force all of them to run.

When the description presents two or more alternative ways that can each establish the same condition and then lead to the same next step: Model an exclusive gateway that splits into one task (or activity) per alternative, and merge the branches back with an exclusive merge gateway before the shared next step, so that the alternatives are not left as unconnected or unmerged paths.

result.rule: Use lanes to partition one process by a stated role, department, system or responsibility; lanes are not separate processes.
Several unconditional outgoing flows from one activity can all proceed. Use a gateway when the description requires a decision or synchronization.
Lanes may be nested: a lane can contain a child laneSet that partitions it further; every flowNodeRef at any depth references nodes of the one owning process.
Use an event-based gateway when the first occurring event selects the path. Target supported catching events or receive tasks, not ordinary tasks.
Each lane flowNodeRef identifies a node in the owning process. Assign nodes according to stated responsibility and avoid arbitrary membership.
Put each flow node, including gateways and events, in exactly one lane.
